scope: FIRST restricted dry Bishop diagnostic for the actual declared 40-degree drained geometry; not global FoS, MPM validation or a reason to force equilibrium
normalPolicy: Keep raw negative normals/counts/minimum stress. Never clamp or reject a root to obtain desired stability. Report minimum over all formal roots and separately the subset with nonnegative normals, without calling either physical/global validation.
decisionLimit: Inconclusive or formal F near/below1 means do not assume drained stable equilibrium or blindly extend prep. F above1 in this restricted family does not prove global stability. No parameter changes or full solver launch follow automatically.
